items.title: Villa take first points but rue missed chances in Hull stalemate
items.description: Aston Villa picked up their first Premier League point of the season, but were left to rue missed chances in their 0-0 draw against Hull City.

items.title: Glasner and Williams dispute VAR call over Forest handball
items.description: Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner and Neco Williams believe VAR should not have ruled out defender's goal against Tottenham.

items.title: Williams goal 'should not have been disallowed' - Glasner
items.description: Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner says his side "lost two points" following their goalless draw against Tottenham Hotspur. The Austrian insists and says Neco Williams' second-half disallowed goal should have stood.

Fernandez and Ndiaye show signs of promise on Man City debuts
items.description: Manchester City gave £185m of deadline-day talent their Premier League debuts in the win over Coventry - and manager Enzo Maresca will have enjoyed what he saw.

items.title: 'One of our best first halves' - Le Bris pleased despite Brentford draw
items.description: Sunderland manager Regis Le Bris claims his side played "one of their best halves" in the Premier League, but rued the opportunity to take all three points following their 1-1 draw at Brentford.

items.title: 'Not Football Manager' - De Zerbi says misfiring Spurs need time
items.description: Tottenham have failed to score in their opening three Premier League games and manager Roberto de Zerbi says it will take time to build his expensive squad into a team.

items.title: Pompey boss apologises as Cardiff's Bielik clashes with fan
items.description: Portsmouth head coach John Mousinho apologises to Cardiff City players after an incident involving home fans at Fratton Park during their Championship match.
